body:
# BringIn

This is a mod for the 2025 April Fools update, [Craftmine](https://www.minecraft.net/ja-jp/article/the-craftmine-update), that allows players to bring items from the Hub into the Mine.


## New Tags

In addition to the vanilla tags, this mod introduces two new tags.  
Assign these tags to items using a datapack or similar method.

Note that `bringin:keep_on_death` requires KeepInventory to be enabled in order to function.

| Tag Name                 | Effect                                           |
|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `minecraft:carry_over`   | Prevents items from being converted to XP when returning from the Mine to the Hub |
| `bringin:bring_in`       | Allows items to be brought from the Hub into the Mine |
| `bringin:keep_on_death`  | Allows items to be carried back to the Hub even when the player dies in the Mine |


## Preventing Reward Loss

In vanilla, when returning rewards such as trophies from the Mine, items are lost if the player's Hub inventory is full and cannot accept them.  
This mod changes the behavior so that any overflow items are dropped in the Hub instead of disappearing.
